exact_claim_text: Within the synthetic eligible study set, immediate diagnostic feedback is associated with short-task correction outcomes more consistently than with durable learning outcomes, which remain sparsely measured.
method_or_source: Protocol-defined eligibility, duplicate and companion-publication resolution, appraisal and synthesis by feedback mechanism and outcome class.
uncertainty: Synthetic corpus, illustrative searches, study heterogeneity, publication-to-study resolution and no quantitative pooling.
boundary: Synthetic protocol and illustrative study set; no claim of exhaustive current coverage or pooled effect.
counter_evidence_or_alternative: Several studies report no durable learning advantage and one companion publication reverses the apparent sample count.
stronger_wording_rejected: Automated feedback improves programming education overall.
